Tetracromia is a short recreational experiment: 14 tile choices, 12 dot-field choices, and 3 ordering arcs. Each observation stays separate.
Tetracromia 是一项简短的娱乐性实验：14次色块选择、12次点阵选择和3段排序弧。每项观察结果都会单独呈现。
三项简短的屏幕色彩观察。
The displayed difference adapts during two tasks.
显示的差异会在两项任务中自适应变化。
Tile choices and Dot fields use a two-correct-down, one-error-up rule. With only 14 and 12 choices, the ending level describes this run; it is not a stable threshold.
色块选择和点阵使用答对两次减小差异、答错一次增大差异的规则。由于分别只有14次和12次选择，最终水平只描述本次测量，并不是稳定阈值。
Correct and missed choices change the next displayed difference.
正确和错误选择会改变下一次显示的差异。
Three observations describe this screen, light, fatigue level, and run—with no composite.
三项观察描述当前屏幕、光线、疲劳程度和本次测量，不会合成总分。
A C-shaped target becomes harder to separate from its field. Three independent staircases record where each short display-relative track ends during this run.
C形视标会逐渐变得更难与背景区分。三条独立阶梯记录本次测量中各条屏幕相对轨迹的结束位置。
